The '''Homeland Civilization''', or '''Rover's Civilization''', is the far-away motherland of [[Rover]] and a space-faring civilisation. It created the [[Exostrider|Exostriders]] and [[Sentinels]] to defend Solaris and possibly other planets from the threat of the [[Threnodian|Threnodians]]. They sent Rover on their mission to defeat [[The Lament|the Lament]], created the mysterious communications satellite swallowed by [[Aleph-1]], and cut off Rover after they begged to be allowed home. It is unknown if the civilisation is unwilling or unable to re-establish contact with Solaris.

The Tethys Institute, a [[Pre-Lament Civilization|pre-Lament]] organisation, may have been a part of this civilisation and created the [[Resolution K626|plan]] which lead to the creation of [[The Black Shores|the Black Shores]] to safeguard humanity.

It may be related to the {{Lang|Hé civilisation|zh=禾文明}} discovered by researchers in [[Whining Aix's Mire]], the portals created by the rogue researchers of the [[Court of Savantae Ruins]], and the [[Mysterious Woman|mysterious woman]] from the beginning of the game.<!--
